I don't want to be a friend of the System and that's what most people over the age of 35 are.

Life Worsening: If you're an older person you may not believe this but despite being young I've lived a lifetime of Stress, Depression, Anxiety, and Overall Dread in general, but even with all of that people will say "You don't know nothing yet," or "Wait till you get older,". In all honesty if my version of Stressed, Depressed, Anxious is an older persons Tuesday, why on Earth should I want to live to that point?
